svg.aria-label: Multi-team agentic engineering orchestration — 4-tier hierarchy including engineer
svg.title: Multi-Team Agentic Orchestration v2
svg.desc: Left-to-right 4-column flow diagram: You/Engineer dispatches to Orchestrator (Tier 1), which delegates to 3 Team Leads (Tier 2), each coordinating 3 Workers (Tier 3). Monochrome dark theme with tier-specific accent colors. 15s looping animation.
